Title: Cross-Engine Seam — Inventory Change Still Reaches Search-Driven Availability on a Store With a Fulfillment Center
Preconditions: state from BGJ-001 (BackgroundJobs migration modules deployed on {{BACK_URL}}, Hangfire active); vc-module-search 3.1006.0 is NOT migrated. CONFIRMED LIVE on a second engine, do not re-derive: this case previously hardcoded {{STORE_ID}} (B2B-store) and PROD_OOS, and PASSed on vcst-qa but went BLOCKED on vcptcore-qa — root cause was NOT the engine and NOT search config (both indexation settings were true there), it was that B2B-store has mainFulfillmentCenterId=null and an empty additionalFulfillmentCenterIds: with no fulfillment center attached, a trackInventory=true product on that store can NEVER report in-stock (proven with controls on vcptcore-qa: a product with 2838 units still read OOS there, and all 26 in-stock products on B2B-store there have trackInventory=false). The earlier PASS on vcst-qa was therefore incidental, not a correct green. REQUIRED PRECONDITION: a store with a non-null mainFulfillmentCenterId (or a non-empty additionalFulfillmentCenterIds) AND a trackInventory=true product with an inventory record at that FC must be discovered live — never hardcode a store name or a specific fulfillment-center id (e.g. do not hardcode B2B-loyalty/Clothing/store2 or their FC ids even though they are known on this env to qualify; they are context for THIS finding, not fixtures to pin). If no such store/product pairing is discoverable, report BLOCKED:PRECONDITION_UNMET:NO_STORE_WITH_FULFILLMENT_CENTER rather than running against a store that structurally cannot express availability. Do NOT work around a missing FC by picking a trackInventory=false product instead — that makes the assertion vacuous, since availability never depends on stock for those. If the Catalog.Search.EventBasedIndexation.Enable and/or VirtoCommerce.Search.IndexingJobs.Enable settings are false on this env, the search-reflection assertion below is NOT evaluable — report it BLOCKED (reason PRECONDITION_UNMET:SEARCH_INDEXING_DISABLED), not FAIL; the non-search assertions in this case remain evaluable

[SETUP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings to check Catalog.Search.EventBasedIndexation.Enable and VirtoCommerce.Search.IndexingJobs.Enable — if either is false, this case's search assertion will be reported BLOCKED, not FAIL
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/search, then for each candidate GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{id} — capture the first store whose mainFulfillmentCenterId is non-null OR whose additionalFulfillmentCenterIds is non-empty, as store_id + fc_id. If none found: STOP and report BLOCKED:PRECONDITION_UNMET:NO_STORE_WITH_FULFILLMENT_CENTER
[SETUP] within store_id's catalog, discover a product with trackInventory=true and an existing inventory record at fc_id — capture product_id. If none found: STOP and report BLOCKED:PRECONDITION_UNMET:NO_STORE_WITH_FULFILLMENT_CENTER (a qualifying store exists but no usable tracked product does)
[HTTP] PUT {{BACK_URL}}/api/inventory/products/{product_id} to set InStockQuantity > 0 at fc_id (confirmed route; the previous bare PUT /api/inventory does not exist)
[WAIT] poll the storefront xAPI products(storeId: store_id, ...) query, or the storefront PDP, for product_id every 15s up to 120s for availability to flip (confirmed route; REST GET /api/search/{store}/products does not exist)
Assertions:
